_note: T21 (phase A): the first dungeon's rooms. crates/core/src/dungeon.rs reads this file, compiled in. Each room is a space of its own, built high over the land far north of the region (`origin_m`: x east, y up, z south), so nothing in the overworld is near it and it is drawn only from inside it (the places' 3 km fade). A room is a box: its floor at the origin's height, walls round it, a ceiling. Positions inside a room are centimetres from its centre, x east, z south, as on the journal's mockups. `ledges` and `pillars` are raised floors you stand on (their tops in centimetres over the room's floor); a `ramp` climbs from one height to another along x. A door stands in a wall (`wall`: n, s, e or w) `along_cm` from the wall's middle, on a sill `top_cm` up; it leads to another room's door, out to the world, or is closed with a line. Colours are the room's own (journal: rooms.svg), 0 to 255.
_origin_m: 11 km north of the village, beyond the far ring of mountains, 1.9 km up: dungeon.rs's tests hold every room's floor at least 100 m over the land under it
_outside: the great tree in the forest (journal: map.svg, entrance.svg): its trunk's middle, its door facing south on the trunk's face (trunk_cm out), the tree tree_cm tall. Out of the dungeon the player stands out_cm in front of the door. Two sockets stand either side of the door (side_cm along the trunk's face, up_cm up); an orb from the roots' bulb, turned by the player's blade within aim_deg of a dark socket, flies straight to it, and lights it when it passes within catch_cm. Both lit, the door opens. The bulb sits at_cm from the trunk's middle (x east, y up, z south) and throws the trainer's single slow orb at the player every `every` ticks while they are within range_cm and the door is shut.

rooms._decor: the hub's roots: strands hanging from the ceiling (their ends at least 7.5 m up, over every hop), ridges up the walls, and glowing mushrooms at the feet of the walls and pillars, placed from the seed
rooms._pillars: x, z, radius, top (cm): six-sided root pillars; the one at (0, 250) holds the healing spring
rooms._ledges: x0, z0, x1, z1, top (cm): the entrance's ledge (south), the left door's (west), the right door's (east), the centre door's (north)
rooms._ramps: x0, z0, x1, z1, height at x0, height at x1 (cm): the slope back up from the floor to the entrance's ledge, along the south wall
rooms._ants: where the floor's ants hatch (cm), on the floor between the pillars (critters.rs)

rooms._id: the left prong's first room, the root-pillar maze (journal: plan.svg, rooms.svg): in from the hub's left door on the east ledge, out by the west ledge's door. Two branches drop to lower pillars (2.2 m, then 1.4 m) that a hop cannot climb back from: a corner you are stuck in, with a small chest at its end, and the floor's ramp back up to the east ledge
rooms._chests: small chests, on top of a pillar or a ledge (cm); E opens one once and takes what it holds (no bombs yet: CW-Q32)

rooms._id: the left prong's second room, the rotting roots: pillars again, grey and mouldy, with infected bulbs on the walls that throw slow orbs at the player while they are near. A blade imbued turns an orb, and an orb turned toward a bulb within the aim bursts it
rooms._bulbs: infected bulbs on the walls (x, y up, z, cm)

rooms._id: the vine's den: a ring of roots round one long vine (vine.rs). Its only door is the way back
rooms._chests: phase E: a chest on a 4 m ledge reached only by hooking the plate over it and dropping

rooms._id: the hook shrine behind the centre door (phase D; journal: rooms.svg, 'a clean, lit shrine for the hookshot'): the hookshot in a small chest on a dais, and on the north wall, over a 3 m ledge no hop reaches, a hook plate low enough to aim at (the view looks up 34° at most, so a plate higher than its distance allows cannot be aimed at). From the ledge a door leads out onto the bark (phase E)
rooms._ledges: the dais (40 cm, stepped onto) and the 3 m ledge before the way out, past any hop (0.49 m)
rooms._plates: hook plates, each in a wall (n, s, e or w) along_cm from its middle and up_cm over the floor

rooms._id: phase E: the first arena inside the trunk, between branches b2 and b3: in by the south door, out by the north, sealed by roots until its foes are down (arenas.rs)
phase E: the second arena, between branch b5 and the crown

phase F: the Ant King's cone, behind the crown's gate. In on a balcony at the rim, 12 m up the south wall; the cone's platforms slide down its walls to the king at its foot (king.rs). Roots hold the door until the king is down
the right prong's first room, the ants' roots: in from the hub's right door on a west ledge, a ramp down to the floor, three ants among clumps of root, out by the north door

the right prong's second room, the lashing vines: two walls of root make a path that winds west, east and west again, and a vine rooted in the middle of each stretch whips round over the floor, so the way through is timed between its passes (vine whips: lashers.rs)
rooms._ledges: walls of root 6 m tall: the floor's three stretches, joined at the west end of the first wall and the east end of the second
rooms._lashers: vines rooted at_cm, each a whip len_cm long lying over the floor and turning round its root once every `period` ticks, `phase` ticks into its turn at the start (lashers.rs)

rooms._id: the shield ant's den (shield_ant.rs): a round of clay and egg clusters. Its only door is the way back

climb._branches: phase E (climb.rs; journal: climb.svg): branches out from the great tree's trunk, each yaw_deg round it (the way it points out, as a heading) with its top top_cm over the ground at the trunk. A branch with a plate is reached by a hook plate in the trunk over it (plate_up_cm over its top, so a hang drops onto it); one without is reached by a door. Each hooked branch is 45° on from the last and 4 m up: from a branch's tip the next plate is 7.8 m across and 5 m up, 9.2 m off and 33° up, inside the hookshot's reach and the view's 35°, and in sight round the trunk's curve (a 6 m trunk seen from 10.75 m out shows 56° of its face either side; at 60° the plate was behind the curve, R9.501)
climb._crown: the crown: the trunk's top, a platform half_cm each way from its middle, top_cm up; the save fountain, the healing pool and the boss door stand on it
climb._waystone: T34 (the person: "there should be waystone at the boss door"): a waystone on the crown before the boss's door, at_cm from the trunk's middle, west of the dais and clear of the braziers; it faces the door (36 degrees east of north), so travel and a fall to it leave the player 4 m in front of it, facing the door (data/travel.json's crown point)
climb._gate: T31 (the person: "the boss door needs to be made much more majestic and cool looking, and not just float there in free space"): the boss's door stands at the crown's north edge (at_cm from the trunk's middle), facing in, set in a wall of bark wall_cm across, up and thick, crowned with points, between two towers tower_cm round and high with gold spires; its doorway is door_cm, two bronze leaves under a gold arch, with columns and the king's crest over it; two braziers stand brazier_cm out and aside. The wall, the towers and the braziers are solid (climb.rs, gate_parts)
climb._doors: doors on the bark: each in the trunk at the root of its branch (or on the crown, facing yaw_deg, by default south), facing out
climb._fall_cm: landing this far below the last branch stood on, near the tree, the view fades and the player stands on that branch again (CW-Q31: no harm)

_attack_ant: the arenas' enemy (attack_ant.rs): an ant on two legs with a blade in each of its two hands. Within sense_cm of the player it turns to them (turn_deg_s) and walks at them (walk_cms) until near_cm off; then winds a blade back (wind_ticks) and slashes it across its front (slash_ticks), left then right, `combo` slashes, then recovers (recover_ticks). Halfway through a slash a player within reach_cm and arc_deg of its front takes `hurt` and a stagger, unless the raised shield covers that side. A blade through its chest (chest_cm up, body_r_cm round) or head is a hit, one each hit_wait ticks; `hits` kill it

king._plates_cm: T36: each plate across, up and out from the foot, on the front of the column the hook stops on (body_r_cm round), never inside it: the bottom two had sat 50 cm inside, so the body took every line to them

_king: the Ant King's fight, phase 1 (king.rs; the journal's entry 22). The cone: its wall drawn from cone_cm's foot radius to its rim radius and top; `platforms` platforms (platform_cm a side, platform_thick_cm thick) evenly round the room, each sliding from the rim (rim_cm: radius, top) to the foot (foot_cm) over slide_ticks, the next a twelfth behind, then back at the rim. A fall to the floor puts you back on the platform you last stood on (the balcony if it is past three quarters of its slide), hurt fall_hurt. The king stands at the foot, height_cm tall and body_r_cm round, turning to you at turn_deg_s, with five gold plates (plates_cm: across, up, out from its middle, turned with it; plate_half_cm half a side) the hookshot takes. Hung on a plate, every key of W, A, S, D that differs from the last fills its hold by one of hold_keys; it drains in hold_drain_ticks, and each shake_every ticks the king shakes off shake_pct of it (T31: at six keys a second a plate tears off in under 3 s; the first numbers, 120, 90 and 25, needed more than eight a second to hold even). Full, the plate tears off and you fall. Every slap_every ticks it winds a slap for slap_wind ticks and sweeps slap_arc_deg either side of its front out to slap_reach_cm: on a platform there you take slap_hurt and are knocked off (its great right arm, drawn back and swept across). Each slam_every ticks, halfway, it slams: both arms over your spot for slam_wind ticks, a ring slam_r_cm round it; standing in it you take slam_hurt and are knocked off. The hook points save you: on posts of root at hook_posts_deg, hook_post_r_cm from the foot, a plate facing in to the foot at each of hook_ups_cm. Every spells.every ticks, halfway between, it casts a spell of its own (spells.rs), by turns: a brood of brood_count ants onto your platform, crawling at brood_cms and biting for brood_bite each brood_bite_every ticks from brood_reach_cm; or drop_count orbs over you (on your feet and drop_spread_cm ahead and behind), drop_high_cm up, hanging drop_linger ticks over rings where they land, then falling at drop_cms, drop_hurt each within drop_r_cm. Phase 2: all five plates off, the platforms are gone, the cone's wall sinks and the king shrinks to small_cm over shrink_ticks; then it is a fighter (pilots.json's ant_king, pose.rs's AntKing), and the duel is on the flat floor. Down, the door opens and the save keeps it
_locks: a door's padlocks (phase D): E with a padlock's key opens it, and the door leads on only once each is open (dungeon.rs, use_door). A key opens its padlock and is kept
_hook: the hookshot (hookshot.rs): aimed from eye_cm over the feet along the view, it reaches items.json's reach_m; its hook flies at fly_cms and, caught in a hook plate (a square plate_cm half a side), pulls the player at pull_cms to hang with their feet hang_below_cm under the plate and hang_out_cm out from it
_lash: a lashing vine's whip that passes within width_cm of a player's body on the floor takes `hurt` health and staggers them `stagger` ticks, no more than once every `every` ticks a vine
_shield_ant: the right prong's mini-boss (shield_ant.rs; journal: shield.svg): standing upright, a shield on its front arm. While the player is within sense_cm it turns its shield toward them at turn_deg_s, slower than they can circle it close in, and walks at them (walk_cms) until near_cm off. With them within bash_cm and within bash_arc_deg of its front it draws the shield back (wind_ticks: the warning) and bashes (bash_ticks): `hurt` and a stagger if they are still there. Then it recovers, turning at recover_turn_pct of its speed: the opening. A blade swept through its belly (belly_cm up, belly_r_cm round) or its head is a hit, unless it meets the shield: within shield_arc_deg of its front and under shield_top_cm. `hits` hits, no more than one each hit_wait ticks, kill it, and its key lies where it fell. Its body keeps others out within body_cm
_bulb_every: a room's bulbs throw the trainer's single slow orb every `bulb_every` ticks each, in turn, at a player within `bulb_range_cm`; they come back whenever the player comes into the room, as the ants do
_vine: the vine mini-boss (vine.rs; journal: vine.svg): rooted at_cm from its room's middle. While the player is within sense_cm it coils (coil_ticks), rears back (rear_ticks: the warning), and lunges its head straight at where the player's chest was as the lunge began, beyond_cm past it, at most reach_cm from its root, over lunge_ticks. A head that passes within hit_cm of the player's chest takes `hurt` health, once a lunge. The neck then lies stretched out_ticks before it draws back (back_ticks). A blade swung across the neck (within neck_cm + cut_gap_cm of it) while it lunges or lies out cuts it, once a lunge, and it draws back at once; `cuts` cuts kill it, and its key lies where its root was. Nothing else hurts it
_door_reach_cm: E opens a door from this close to its middle
_door_inside_cm: through a door, the player stands this far in from it, facing into the room
_dark_ticks: a door fades the view out over these ticks, moves the player, then holds the dark and fades back in
_heal_per_tick: standing in a healing spring restores this much health a tick (60 a second) up to full
